g.text: Corrected structural matched-evidence study: 5 worlds × 3 initial-model arms. All arms received the same direct phase-process evidence; the five-world contrast is

text.style: font-size: 6.25px; font-family: 'Arial', 'Helvetica', 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif; fill: #667780

g.text: descriptive and non-confirmatory. Parametric matched evidence separately yielded 5/5 wrong-direction rejections and 5/5 peak-and-collapse summaries.
